verbs.description: Worker reaches into a bin, tray or rack and lifts a part out, hand closing on it.
Worker lowers a held part onto the unit or fixture and releases it.
Worker pushes a part into a hole, slot or socket on the unit, aligning it with both hands.
Worker drives a fastener with a handheld screwdriver or torque driver held against the unit.
Worker joins a cable, plug, hose or connector to a mating part; includes crimping and wiring.
Worker holds a gas torch with a visible flame against a pipe joint.
Worker looks closely at the unit, scans it with a handheld scanner, or watches a test rig while the unit is connected; hands mostly still.
Worker walks away from the unit, e.g. to fetch something, with no part being worked on.
Worker looks through bins or shelves for a part, hands moving between containers without a clear pick.

parts.name: Base pan
parts.hint: large flat sheet-metal tray the unit is built on

parts.name: Screw
parts.hint: small fasteners, usually only visible with a screwdriver
